userStories.title: Configure Jenkins Multibranch Pipeline with Loop Prevention
userStories.description: As a platform engineer, I need to configure the Jenkins pipeline with loop-prevention so PlatformBot commits never trigger builds.
acceptanceCriteria: Bitbucket Branch Source trait configured with author filter: ^(?!PlatformBot).*$
Pipeline commits use [ci skip] marker as defensive layer
GitOps update stage only touches apps/<svc>/workload/overlays/dev/
Push retry logic (5 attempts with rebase) implemented
Pipeline uses git -c user.name=PlatformBot for commits
End-to-end test: commit to service repo → image built → image tag updated in platform-gitops
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented on 2026-05-21 by extending the Jenkins addon bootstrap in `gitops/bootstrap/control-plane/addons/oss/addons-jenkins-appset.yaml` and `gitops/environments/default/addons/jenkins/values.yaml`. Jenkins now installs the Bitbucket multibranch support plugins (`cloudbees-bitbucket-branch-source`, `bitbucket`, `pipeline-multibranch-defaults`, `config-file-provider`, and `bitbucket-scm-trait-commit-skip`), converts the Bitbucket workspace token into a `usernamePassword` credential for Bitbucket Cloud access, seeds a centrally managed default multibranch Jenkinsfile, and bootstraps a Bitbucket multibranch job for the configured service repository. The default pipeline commits with `git -c user.name=PlatformBot`, includes the defensive `[ci skip]` marker, only rewrites `apps/<svc>/workload/overlays/dev/`, and retries the GitOps push up to 5 times with `git pull --rebase`. The SCM source is also patched with `WebhookConfigurationTrait.committersToIgnore("PlatformBot")` and `BitbucketBranchCommitSkipTrait` to prevent bot-authored webhook loops. Local verification passed with `terraform validate`, `terraform fmt`, and `helm template jenkins jenkins/jenkins --version 5.9.22 -f gitops/environments/default/addons/jenkins/values.yaml`. The story remains open because live Bitbucket/Jenkins webhook behaviour and the end-to-end image-build-to-GitOps flow have not been exercised in this workspace, and the exact acceptance criterion of a regex-based author filter (`^(?!PlatformBot).*$`) is approximated here via Bitbucket username ignore traits because that is what the installed Jenkins plugins expose.
